sources.title: Signed development consents for determined NSW data centre State Significant Developments (bulk harvest)
sources.publisher: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure
sources.notes: 20 consent documents downloaded from the portal's public attachment endpoints and archived under data/raw/nsw_planning/consents/ with SHA-256 manifests and per-document extraction yield statistics. 20 extracted above the 20 chars/KB reliability floor and support negative findings; 0 fell below it and are recorded as extraction-limited, NOT as evidence of absence: none. 0 projects were skipped (restricted, oversized or unresolvable). Condition battery and Schedule 1 applicant parsed per document; matrix at exports/nsw_planning/nsw_dc_consent_conditions.csv.

metrics.notes: Signed consents extracted above the reliability floor, so their negative findings are safe to rely on.
Consents whose text extraction fell below the reliability floor. Recorded so that nobody treats a keyword miss in them as evidence of absence.
Of 20 reliably-extracted signed consents for determined NSW data centre SSDs, 5 contain a renewable ppa additionality provision.
Of 20 reliably-extracted signed consents for determined NSW data centre SSDs, 7 contain a pue provision.
Of 20 reliably-extracted signed consents for determined NSW data centre SSDs, 2 contain a nox mass cap provision.
